why_it_is_an_n_plus_one: Captured with -W 1, so the route-service worker pool is one and the same eleven calls run one after another. Nothing else about the request changed.
notes: Whole trace, 40 spans, nothing removed. Paired with n_plus_one_full_concurrent, which is the same shape at -W 3.

The pair isolates timing: identical services, identical call graph, identical span count. Only the concurrency differs, so a procedure that decides on repetition alone gets exactly one of the two right.
